description:
kith-store/src/lib.rs lines 18-24: PeerBlobInfo is a pub struct with five pub fields returned by Store::get_peer_mailbox_for_blob(). It has no #[non_exhaustive] attribute.

Adding a field to PeerBlobInfo (e.g. message_id, created_at_unix, delivery_state) would be a breaking change for any external code that pattern-matches or constructs it. Since this is a return type from a library function (not something callers construct), #[non_exhaustive] is the correct protection.

Additionally, size_bytes: u64 is an unsigned type while the database stores size as i64 (SQLite INTEGER). The conversion happens internally in get_peer_mailbox_for_blob() (line 862: size_bytes_i64 < 0 check). This is correct, but the public type (u64) differs from the storage type (i64), which means the conversion is always required and adds a failure mode (DB corruption returning negative). Documenting this invariant or using a newtype would make the contract clearer.

Fix: add #[non_exhaustive] to PeerBlobInfo.
title: kith-store: PeerBlobInfo is pub struct without #[non_exhaustive]
